1995.kid: The page and its picture live here, on a tall beige computer far away. Every visitor gets them from this one computer.
1995.nerd: A tower PC or a Unix workstation running one web program (NCSA HTTPd, on most sites in August 1995, or the new Apache). It reads each request and sends the file from its own disk: no cache in front of it, no other copy. CDNs began with Akamai in 1998–99.
